name: Play-first: sofa and ottoman tucked by the stairs facing the window, the biggest play floor on the STOENSE
notes:
Alternative, play-first: No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
The living group tucks into the room's left-hand side by the stairs: the KIVIK faces the window with its back to the open side, and the soft KIVIK ottoman stands in for the coffee table and seats the fourth person. Everything in front of and east of the sofa is open play floor on the TIOKRONA and, 13" beyond it, the 67 x 94" sage STOENSE, from the walkway along the stairs to the toy wall (the floor east of the sofa is 111" wide, 75" before), with the SMÅSTAD reading bench and a KALLAX 2x2 of toy drawers on the upper section, the low BESTÅ toy cabinet and its FLISAT book display in the 50" left of the open side's walkway, the LÄTT table, and Maddie's POÄNG facing her books.
sofa-1 KIVIK, rot 180, x 58-147.75, y 102-139.375: its front 96" from the heater face (F-33, 12" needed); its back 3.6" short of the open side's 30" walkway (F-39, F-42); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
ottoman-1 KIVIK ottoman with storage, x 85.188-120.562, y 58.5-86: 16" in front of the sofa (F-39), 52.5" from the heater face (F-33); soft, no corners, machine-washable cover; drinks go on a tray or the side table.
side-table-1 LACK side table with lamp-1 STORSEGEL at the sofa's left arm, x 36.375-58, y 117.75-139.375, beside the walkway along the stairs; floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP at the right arm (x 147.75-156.75, y 128-137); plant-1 FEJKA by the walkway (x 39-48, y 100-109).
rug-1 TIOKRONA 118 x 94", x 39-157, y 46-140: under the sofa's front, the ottoman and the open floor in front of them, which is play floor too; the TÅGARP and the plant stand on it, the side table 2.6" over its edge; two STOPP FILT underlays under it keep it from sliding.
rug-4 STOENSE 67 x 94" pale green, x 170-237, y 48.5-142.5: the play floor, under the LÄTT and Maddie's POÄNG, with 13" of bare floor between it and the TIOKRONA rather than butted against it (the two differ by 1/2" in thickness); one STOPP FILT underlay under it, the one its page names.
toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD reading bench in the window corner, right-upper wall x 240.5-261, y 18-53.375: 12" from the heater face (F-33); its boxes keep 24" (F-32); wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST above it and the LÖVA canopy over it (an extra, 12"+ off the heater face). Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
bookcase-2 KALLAX 2x2 with four KALLAX drawer inserts (eight toy drawers), right-upper wall x 245.625-261, y 62.875-93: anchor-required (F-21, 30 1/8"); 24" clear in front (F-32). art-2 RÖDALM centered above it (19 3/4" over its 30 1/8", two thirds).
toy-cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors 47 1/4 x 16 1/2 x 15", standing on the floor against the right-lower wall, x 259-275.5, y 94.75-142 (F-63): push-open Lappviken doors at her height with DRÖNA boxes inside, no glass, 15" tall; 24" clear in front (F-32); 1" short of the walkway (F-42). book-display-1 FLISAT stands on its end by the step (top layer), wall-lamp-2 VARPTROSS above it (center about 66" up, out of her reach from the floor, its cord in a cover down behind the cabinet), and art-1 PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies over the rest of the cabinet (y 114-141.5), no longer past its end.
kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 180-204.75, y 92-110.875, on the STOENSE: 32.25" from the sofa's right arm, the way from the dining side onto the play floor (F-30); well outside the KALLAX's 24" (F-32: its zone starts at x 221.6) and the BESTÅ's.
kid-chair-1 POÄNG kid's armchair facing east to her books, x 212-234, y 124-142.5: 1" outside the BESTÅ's 24" (F-32), 0.5" short of the walkway (F-42), 15" from the LÄTT's corner.
Right side (F-61): the right-lower wall carries the BESTÅ (47 1/4" of the 50" left of the walkway), the 93" right-upper wall the SMÅSTAD and the KALLAX 2x2.
Not placed: the TV and every TV unit (F-65); the LILJETRÄD mirror (glass, F-21); the 70 7/8" BESTÅ drawer combination (it would reach into the open side's walkway); the PERJOHAN bench that backed the sofa (the sofa's back is on the open side now); the LACK coffee table and console (the ottoman replaces the table; a console would stand in the walkway); the POÄNG armchair (the ottoman is the fourth seat); the chaise sofa (c); TROFAST (a, b); KALLAX 2x4 (c); LEN and VALLABY rugs (a, b, c); the BISSA and hooks (the bottom wall is open); the LAUTERS (e).
Stairs: they run outside the left wall, beyond the measured 261" (F-40; Andrew, 2026-10-24: the stairs add to the room, they are not cut from it), so the floor is whole up to that wall. The stair side is a railing (Andrew, 2026-10-24), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included (y 0-36 and y 137-173): it is the walkway between the stairs' two ends, and nothing Maddie can climb stands at the railing (F-40, F-21). The bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the strip and the route along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown (assumed-position:stairs).
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there, nothing stands under it (F-38), and no art hangs on that wall, so the window is the focal point.
Entry: the old shoe cabinet, hooks and mirror hung on the bottom wall, which is open, so they are gone. The LILJETRÄD mirror that moved to the window wall above the top landing is off the plan too: it is glass (F-21).
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; the KALLAX 2x2 is anchored; the ottoman is soft, with no corners; the two rugs no longer meet in a 1/2" step where she runs.
Power: the stair side is a railing and the bottom side is open, so outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are is not recorded. The UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords run down the play wall in cord covers. The side table's STORSEGEL and the TÅGARP need flat floor cord covers to one of those walls, never across the strip along the railing or the open side's walkway and never under a rug; the TÅGARP's cord is 3' 3", so it needs an extension, or a cordless lamp in its place.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, KALLAX insert with 2 drawers x4, DRÖNA boxes x3 (inside the BESTÅ), LÖVA canopy x1, STOPP FILT underlays x3 (two under the TIOKRONA, one under the STOENSE).
Audit 2026-10-24: the LILJETRÄD mirror is off the plan, because it is glass and F-21 allows none. The STOENSE (3/4" pile) had been butted against the TIOKRONA (1/4" flatweave), a 1/2" step where Maddie runs and a seam that reads as a patch: it moved 14" east and 6.5" toward the open side, leaving 13" of floor between them and taking in her POÄNG, and the TIOKRONA moved 1" east so the TÅGARP no longer stands across its edge. The LÄTT moved 8" east, so the way past the sofa's right arm is 32.25", not 24.25" (F-30). Three STOPP FILT underlays keep the rugs from sliding, as in the dining room. A VARPTROSS wall lamp, the dining room's bamboo sconce, gives the play corner its own light. The RÖDALM left the window wall, where it hung over the heater and behind the curtains' stack, for the KALLAX, and the Waterlilies no longer runs past the BESTÅ's end. These notes now record the railing (F-40) and the lamp cords.
